article.title: Wiesbaden notes
article.excerpt: Who goes to Wiesbaden these days? The era of Russian nobles taking the cure here and gambling is long since gone. And yet here we are. The proximate cause of this trip is the desire to see Grigory Sokolov , one of the world’s great pianists and a cult figure of sorts.
